channel.title: Scholaradar: scholarships for citizens of Mongolia
channel.description: New scholarships and fellowships open to citizens of Mongolia, with deadlines.

item.title: Adlerbert Study Scholarships at Chalmers University of Technology 2026-2027 | Scholars4Dev
item.description: Eligible. Deadline 2027-01-15. Sweden, master, full. Open to 1st year Master's programme applicants who are citizens of 143 developing countries. Selection is based on academic excellence, including weighted average grade and home university stature. Evidence: “The Alderbert Study Scholarships offers scholarships to students who are citizens of one of 143 countries.”

item.title: Maastricht University NL-High Potential Scholarships for International Students 2026-2027 | Scholars4Dev
item.description: Eligible. Deadline 2027-02-01. Netherlands, master, full. Highly talented international students from countries outside the EU/EEA, Switzerland, or Surinam who have been admitted to a participating Master's programme at Maastricht University. Applicants must be under 35 years of age by 1 September 2027, have a GPA of 7.5/10 or higher, and must not have previously completed a degree-seeking programme in the Netherlands. Evidence: “You hold nationality in a country outside the EU/EEA, Switzerland or Surinam and meet the requirements for obtaining an entry visa and residence permit for the Netherlands.”

item.title: ENS International Selection Scholarships 2026-2027 | Scholars4Dev
item.description: Eligible. Deadline 2026-12-15. France, master, full. International students under 26 years old who have not previously applied to the International Selection and have not lived in France for more than 10 months in the current or previous academic year. Applicants must have completed at least one year of undergraduate studies at a foreign university. Evidence: “Each year, École Normale Supérieure (ENS) organizes an international selection allowing the most promising international students, either in Science or in Arts & Humanities, to follow a Masters Degree at the University.”

item.title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters scholarships
item.description: Eligible. Multiple, master, full. Students at the master's level from all over the world can apply. Applicants must have a bachelor's degree or be in their final year of bachelor studies. Evidence: “Students at master's level from all over the world can apply.”

item.title: БНХАУ-ын Засгийн газрын тэтгэлэгт хамрагдах тухай түгээмэл асуулт хариулт
item.description: Eligible. China, full. The scholarship is for the 2025/2026 academic year. Applicants must obtain a pre-admission letter from their chosen university to be eligible for the Chinese Government Scholarship. Evidence: “Published by Chinese Embassy in Mongolia мэдэгдэл”

item.title: Asian Development Bank–Japan Scholarship Program 2026 (Fully Funded) - OYA Opportunities
item.description: Eligible. Deadline 2026-12-01. Asia and the Pacific, master, full. Citizens of eligible ADB developing member countries (including Mongolia) with a bachelor's degree, at least two years of professional work experience, and aged 35 or younger. Evidence: “The program is available to citizens of eligible ADB developing member countries, including countries such as Nepal, India, Bangladesh, Bhutan, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Indonesia, the Philippines, Vietnam, Thailand, Cambodia, Mongolia, Fiji, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyz Republic, and Uzbekistan, among others.”

item.title: Hamad Bin Khalifa University Scholarship in Qatar (Fully Funded) - OYA Opportunities
item.description: Eligible. Deadline 2027-02-01. Qatar, bachelor, master, phd, full. Open to international students for undergraduate and graduate programs. Graduate applicants require a degree from a recognized institution and a strong academic record. Undergraduate applicants require a strong high-school record and English proficiency. Evidence: “International students interested in studying in Qatar can explore HBKU’s undergraduate and graduate programs and apply online through the university’s official admissions portal.”

item.title: GLOCAL Erasmus Mundus Scholarship 2027(Fully Funded) - OYA Opportunities
item.description: Eligible. Deadline 2027-01-14. United Kingdom, Germany, Spain, Sweden, Netherlands, Japan, Colombia, master, full. Open to all nationalities. Applicants generally need a UK 2:1 Honours degree or an international equivalent. Applicants whose first language is not English must meet English-language requirements. Evidence: “The GLOCAL Erasmus Mundus Scholarship 2027 offers an exciting opportunity for international students to pursue a two-year international master’s degree focused on global markets, local creativity, entrepreneurship, culture, and economic development.”

item.title: Harvard Loeb Fellowship 2027–28: Fully Funded - OYA Opportunities
item.description: Eligible. Deadline 2027-01-05. United States, full. Mid-career professionals with at least eight years of experience in fields related to the built and natural environment. Open to all nationalities. Evidence: “Open to | All Nationalities”

item.title: Skoll Scholarship 2027 at Oxford University (Fully Funded) - OYA Opportunities
item.description: Eligible. Deadline 2027-01-06. United Kingdom, postdoc, master, full. The scholarship is open to all nationalities and is aimed at social entrepreneurs, innovators, and leaders who wish to pursue an Oxford MBA to address social and environmental challenges. Evidence: “Open to | All Nationalities”

item.title: AU Emerging Global Leader Scholarship 2027 in USA | Fully Funded
item.description: Eligible. Deadline 2027-01-15. United States, bachelor, full. International students who are not U.S. citizens, permanent residents, or dual citizens, and who require a non-immigrant student visa (preferably F-1 or J-1). Applicants must be first-year undergraduate students who graduated from secondary school in or after 2024. Evidence: “The AU Emerging Global Leader Scholarship 2027 at American University in Washington, DC, is an outstanding opportunity for international students who want to pursue a fully funded undergraduate degree in the United States.”

item.title: 2026년도 국비유학생(일반, 꿈나래, 기술‧기능인) 선발시험 공고
item.description: Eligible. South Korea, master, phd, full. Applicants must be graduates or expected graduates of a Korean university (including industrial, education, distance, and technical universities) with a bachelor's degree or higher. They must meet specific foreign language proficiency requirements and hold a Level 3 or higher in the Korean History Proficiency Test. Dual citizens must renounce their foreign citizenship before entering the host institution. Evidence: “| 그리스어, 네덜란드어, 라오스어, 말레이시아어·인도네시아어, 몽골어, 미얀마어, 베트남어, 스와힐리어, 스웨덴어, 아랍어, 아제르바이잔어, 우즈베크어, 우크라이나어, 이란어, 이탈리아어, 체코어, 카자흐어, 크로아티아어, 크메르어, 태국어, 터키어, 포르투갈어·브라질어, 폴란드어, 헝가리어, 힌디어 (총25개어) |”

item.title: 2027 年度 日本政府（文部科学省）奨学金留学生募集要項 研 究 留 学 生（大 使 館 推 薦）
item.description: Eligible. Japan, master, research, postdoc, full. Foreign students who are citizens of countries having diplomatic relations with the Japanese government. Applicants must be born after April 2, 1992 (with some exceptions) and possess the necessary academic qualifications for Master's or Doctoral programs in Japan. Evidence: “日本政府と国交のある国の国籍を有すること。”

item.title: 2027年度海外留学支援制度（学部学位取得型）募集要項（都道府県推薦枠）
item.description: Eligible. Japan, bachelor, full. Japanese nationals or permanent residents of Japan who are expected to graduate from a high school in Japan in March 2027 and intend to pursue a bachelor's degree at a university abroad. Evidence: “109 大韓民国 F 189,000 110 ラオス H 139,000 111 マカオ B 297,000 112 マレーシア D 239,000 113 モンゴル H 139,000 114 ミャンマー H 139,000 115 ネパール H 139,000 116 パキスタン H 139,000 117 フィリピン H 139,000”

item.title: 2027年度海外留学支援制度（学部学位取得型）募集要項
item.description: Eligible. Japan, bachelor, full. Japanese nationals or permanent residents of Japan who have not previously enrolled in higher education institutions and intend to contribute to Japan's international competitiveness or international society after completing their studies abroad. Evidence: “109 大韓民国 F 189,000 110 ラオス H 139,000 111 マカオ B 297,000 112 マレーシア D 239,000 113 モンゴル H 139,000 114 ミャンマー H 139,000 115 ネパール H 139,000 116 パキスタン H 139,000 117 フィリピン H 139,000”

item.title: İç Moğolistan Teknoloji Üniversitesi CSC Bursu 2026
item.description: Eligible. China, bachelor, master, phd, full. The scholarship is open to international students from all countries except Chinese citizens. Applicants must have a high school diploma for undergraduate programs, or a relevant bachelor's or master's degree for postgraduate programs. Proficiency in English is required. Evidence: “CSC Bursu, Çin vatandaşları hariç tüm ülkelerden gelen uluslararası öğrencilere açıktır.”

item.title: Türkiye Bursları
item.description: Eligible. Deadline 2027-02-20. Türkiye, short_course, bachelor, master, phd, research, full. International students from all countries, including graduates or those about to graduate, researchers, and academics. Turkish citizens and those who have lost Turkish citizenship are not eligible. Applicants must meet specific academic success and age criteria based on the level of study. Evidence: “Tüm ülkelerin vatandaşları”

item.title: Begabtenförderung - Stipendien der Friedrich-Naumann-Stiftung
item.description: Eligible. Deadline 2026-10-31. Germany, bachelor, master, phd, full. Scholarships are available for German and international students (undergraduate and graduate) and doctoral candidates from all disciplines. For undergraduate/graduate students, the degree must be at a state-recognized university in Germany, the EU, or Switzerland. Bachelor's degrees for non-EU applicants are specifically excluded. Doctoral candidates from home or abroad are eligible. Evidence: “Die Stiftung für die Freiheit vergibt Stipendien an deutsche und ausländische Studierende.”

item.title: Stipendien für ein Masterstudium im Ausland • DAAD
item.description: Eligible. master, full. Applicants must hold a Bachelor's degree (at least three years) from a state or state-recognized university in Germany or an equivalent foreign degree. Non-German citizens are eligible to apply. The degree must not have been obtained more than five years prior to the application. Evidence: “Eine Bewerbung ist auch möglich, wenn Sie nicht die deutsche Staatsangehörigkeit haben.”

item.title: 清华大学2027年招收国际研究生简章
item.description: Eligible. China, master, phd, full. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens holding a valid foreign passport or proof of nationality. Master's applicants must have a bachelor's degree, and PhD applicants must have a master's degree. Language proficiency in Chinese or English is required as per specific program requirements. Evidence: “申请者须为根据《中华人民共和国国籍法》不具有中国国籍的外国人，申请时须持有效的外国护照或国籍证明文件。”

item.title: 苏州大学外国留学生奖学金
item.description: Unclear. China, master, phd, full. Non-Chinese citizens with a bachelor's degree (for master's applicants) or a master's degree (for PhD applicants) who meet language requirements (HSK 5 for Chinese-taught programs or university English requirements for English-taught programs). Evidence: “非中国籍公民，身心健康；”

item.title: 2027 GKS Undergraduate University Track: Deadlines and Original-Document Submission Stages Vary by University
item.description: Unclear. South Korea, bachelor, full. The Global Korea Scholarship (GKS) is for international students applying to undergraduate programs in South Korea via the University Track.

item.title: 장학금 Scholarships
item.description: Eligible. South Korea, bachelor, master, phd, research, full. Various scholarships are available for international students (undergraduate and graduate) and domestic students. Specific programs like EGPP target female leaders from developing countries (OECD DAC list), while ISS scholarships are based on academic merit or TOPIK scores. Other opportunities include research assistantships, teaching assistantships, and merit-based awards for current students. Evidence: “EGPP (Ewha Global Partnership Program) | | 외국인특별전형으로 학부 또는 일반대학원에 지원 하는 자 중 여성 지도자로서의 성장 가능성이 인 정된 개발도상국 출신 외국인 학생”

item.title: Поступление в МГИМО для иностранцев 2026: четыре пути
item.description: Eligible. Russia, bachelor, master, postdoc, research, short_course, full. International students can apply via the Russian Government quota (through Rossotrudnichestvo), the MGIMO International School Olympiad (for students from 14 specific regions including Mongolia), or via paid contracts for all other foreign nationals. Evidence: “К участию допускаются школьники выпускных классов из 14 стран и регионов: восемь стран СНГ (Азербайджан, Армения, Беларусь, Казахстан, Киргизия, Таджикистан, Туркменистан, Узбекистан), Сербия, Монголия, Индия, Иран, Африка и Латинская Америка.”

item.title: Далянь Гадаад Хэлний Их Сургуулийн CSC 2026 оны тэтгэлэг
item.description: Eligible. China, bachelor, master, phd, full. International students who are not Chinese citizens and meet the educational level and age requirements specified in the CSC guidelines. Evidence: “Хятад бус иргэдийн эрүүл мэнд сайн байна.”

item.title: 2025 онд хамрагдах боломжтой ТЭТГЭЛЭГТ хөтөлбөрүүд
item.description: Eligible. South Korea, bachelor, master, phd, full. The page lists several scholarship opportunities for 2025, including programs for Mongolian citizens to study in South Korea, China, Russia, Hungary, Japan, and Czechia. Evidence: “2025 онд БНСУ-ын Засгийн газрын тэтгэлгээр Монгол улсаас баклаврын зэрэгт суралцах оюутан ЭСЯ-аар дамжуулан сонгон шалгаруулах хөтөлбөр зарлагдаж байгаа тул сонирхсон хүмүүс өргөнөөр оролцоно уу.”

item.title: Admissions - Schwarzman Scholars
item.description: Eligible. Deadline 2027-09-30. China, postdoc, master, full. Prospective scholars must be between 18 and 29 years old by August 1 of their enrollment year. Applicants must demonstrate academic excellence, leadership potential, and strong English proficiency. The program is open to an international pool of candidates from all undergraduate fields of study. Evidence: “Schwarzman Scholars are selected from an international pool of distinguished candidates.”

item.title: [Scholarship Opportunity]: Summer Japan Culture Camp 2026
item.description: Eligible. Japan, full. The program is open to all nationalities who are passionate about international friendship and can adapt easily to new environments. Evidence: “All nationalities can apply”

item.title: Weiss Fund Fellowship for Junior Researchers 2027
item.description: Unclear. Deadline 2027-08-31. phd, full. PhD candidates in Economics or related fields entering academic or research positions in eligible developing countries (per-capita GDP below $13,750). Candidates must be on the 2027–28 job market and must have completed their PhD after 2025. Evidence: “The fellowship is offering supplementary financial support to exceptional economics PhD candidates entering academic or research positions in eligible developing countries.”

item.title: Future Leaders Exchange (FLEX) program
item.description: Eligible. United States, research, postdoc, phd, master, bachelor, exchange, full. Merit-based scholarships for secondary school students to attend high school for one academic year in the United States. Evidence: “AC Mongolia's main source of activity is the Future Leaders Exchange (FLEX) program, which provides merit-based scholarships for secondary school students to attend high school for one academic year in the United States and live with an American host family.”

item.title: 欧亚国家留学生奖学金项目招生简章
item.description: Eligible. China, master, phd, full. The scholarship is open to international students from 13 Eurasian countries, specifically Russia, Belarus, Ukraine, Georgia, Armenia, Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, Kazakhstan, Turkmenistan, Moldova, Azerbaijan, and Mongolia. Evidence: “该项目计划面向欧亚国家，即俄罗斯、白俄罗斯、乌克兰、格鲁吉亚、亚美尼亚、吉尔吉斯斯坦、乌兹别克斯坦、塔吉克斯坦、哈萨克斯坦、土库曼斯坦、摩尔多瓦、阿塞拜疆、蒙古13个...”

item.title: 内蒙古大学2026-2027学年中国政府奖学金“高水平研究生”项目招生简章
item.description: Eligible. China, postdoc, master, phd, full. International students applying for the 2026-2027 Chinese Government Scholarship 'High-Level Postgraduate' program at Inner Mongolia University. Evidence: “中文 English Монгол Русский язык 菜单 首页 留学内大”

item.title: 책임운영기관 교육부 국립국제교육원
item.description: Eligible. South Korea, master, phd, bachelor, short_course, full. Applicants must be citizens of invited countries (excluding South Korean citizens). For graduate programs, applicants must be under 40 (or under 45 if a professor from an ODA recipient country) and have a GPA of 80/100 or higher. For undergraduate programs, applicants must be under 25 and have a GPA of 80/100 or higher. Those who have already graduated from a Korean institution are ineligible. Evidence: “1. 초청대상국 국적을 소지한 자 (대한민국 국적 소지자 지원 불가)”

item.title: 2026 Application Guidelines of Global Korea Scholarship for Undergraduate Degrees(GKS-U) / 2026학년도 정부초청외국인 학부 장학생 모집 요강
item.description: Eligible. South Korea, bachelor, full. International students applying for undergraduate degrees in South Korea. Evidence: “Discover the latest updates and information on scholarships available for international students.”

item.title: 2027 Global Korea Scholarship for Undergraduate Degrees / 2027년 정부초청 외국인 학부 장학생 모집 요강
item.description: Eligible. South Korea, bachelor, full. International students are eligible to apply for the 2027 Global Korea Scholarship for Undergraduate Degrees. Evidence: “Explore scholarship programs offered by the Korean government for international students.”

item.title: 정부초청장학생(GKS) 2026 선발 구조 — 한국어·지역·산학협력 | 수앤캐롯츠
item.description: Eligible. South Korea, bachelor, master, phd, research, language, full. International students from various countries (including 128 countries for graduate programs and 71 countries for undergraduate programs) are eligible. The industry-academic cooperation (UIC) track is open to all countries without restriction. Evidence: “산학협력 과정만 초청국 제한 없이 모든 국가에 열어 둔 것도 같은 맥락이죠.”

item.title: Notice Read | Scholarships | Plan your studies | Study in Korea | Run by Korean Government
item.description: Eligible. South Korea, full. International students are eligible to apply for the 2026 GKS-G program. Evidence: “Explore scholarship programs offered by the Korean government for international students.”

item.title: [외부] 2027-2028 독일정부초청장학생(DAAD 장학생) 선발 안내 | 가톨릭대학교 일반대학원
item.description: Unclear. Germany, bachelor, master, phd, research, full. The scholarship is for doctoral, research, master's, and undergraduate/master's students (summer courses) to study in Germany. Specific eligibility varies by program.

item.title: GKS (Global Korea Scholarship) Program
item.description: Eligible. South Korea, research, master, bachelor, short_course, other, full. International students and their parents must hold non-Korean citizenship. Undergraduate applicants must be under 25, while graduate applicants must be under 40. Applicants must meet specific academic performance requirements. Evidence: “Nationality: Applicants and both of their parents must hold non-Korean citizenship”

item.title: ㈜미성이앤씨·온해피, ESG·SDGs 손잡았다…몽골 유학생 장학금 1천만 원 지원
item.description: Eligible. South Korea, full. Mongolian international students staying in South Korea. Evidence: “㈜미성이앤씨는 국내에 체류 중인 몽골 유학생들의 안정적인 정주와 학업 성취를 돕기 위해 총 1000만 원의 장학금을 조성한다.”

item.title: 2026 年度以降の博士課程学生支援について（通知）
item.description: Unclear. Japan, exchange, postdoc, phd, full. Doctoral students enrolled in a 3-year doctoral program or medical/dental/pharmaceutical courses. Includes both Japanese students and international students, though specific benefits like tuition waivers vary by student status and program affiliation. Evidence: “【学位プロ枠】 学位プログラム等※２に所属する博士課程学生 留学生 ２４０万円 ５３.６万円 －”

item.description: Eligible. Deadline 2026-11-06. Japan, full. International students applying via university recommendation for the MEXT scholarship. Evidence: “Application for Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship Student 2027 [University Recommendation]”

item.title: 2026年度大使館推薦による国費外国人留学生（学部留学生・高等専門学校留学生・専修学校留学生）の募集について：文部科学省
item.description: Eligible. Japan, bachelor, other, full. International students applying through Japanese Embassies/Consulates for undergraduate, college of technology, or specialized training college programs for the 2026 academic year. Evidence: “2026年度大使館推薦による国費外国人留学生（学部留学生・高等専門学校留学生・専修学校留学生）の募集について”

item.title: 国立大・高専で学べる「国費外国人留学生」募集開始…文科省 | リセマム
item.description: Eligible. Japan, bachelor, postdoc, master, phd, language, other, full. International students from countries that have diplomatic relations with Japan. For undergraduate students, applicants must generally be born on or after April 2, 2002, and have completed 12 years of school education. Evidence: “このうち学部留学生は、原則として2002年4月2日以降生まれ、かつ日本と国交のある国の国籍で、学校教育における12年の課程を修了した人（見込みを含む）。”

item.title: 文部科学省外国人留学生制度
item.description: Eligible. Japan, language, bachelor, master, phd, full. International students who are citizens of countries that have diplomatic relations with Japan. Applicants must not hold Japanese nationality at the time of application (with specific exceptions for dual nationals). The program aims to foster individuals who can serve as a bridge between Japan and their home country. Evidence: “（１）国籍日本政府と国交のある国の国籍を有すること。申請時に日本国籍を有する者は原則として募集の対象とならない。”

item.title: 2026年度大使館推薦による国費外国人留学生（研究留学生）の募集について：文部科学省
item.description: Unclear. Japan, research, full. International students applying through Japanese embassies for the 2026 Research Student scholarship program. Evidence: “2026年度大使館推薦による国費外国人留学生（研究留学生）の募集について”

item.title: 2027年度 海外留学支援制度（大学院学位取得型） 募集関連書類が公開されました | ニュース | トビタテ！留学JAPAN | 文部科学省
item.description: Unclear. Japan, master, phd, full. Individuals aiming for graduate school overseas, with support starting between April 2027 and March 2028. Evidence: “2027年度 海外留学支援制度（大学院学位取得型）の募集関連書類が公開になりました。”

item.title: 2027年度（第12期）【高校生等対象】募集要項
item.description: Eligible. Japan, master, bachelor, short_course, full. Japanese high school students (including those in high school, secondary education, special needs high school, technical colleges 3rd year, and vocational high school) currently enrolled in Japanese educational institutions. Evidence: “101 バングラデシュ 109 大韓民国 117 フィリピン 102 ブータン 110 ラオス 191 シンガポール 103 ブルネイ 111 マカオ 119 スリランカ 104 カンボジア 112 マレーシア 120 タイ 105 中国 113 モンゴル 121 ベトナム 106 香港 114 ミャンマー 123 東ティモール 107 インド 115 ネパール 124 モルディブ 中 南”

item.title: 「広島大学森戸国際高等教育学院モンゴル国立科学技術大学留学プログラム」の開講式を開催しました
item.description: Eligible. Japan, bachelor, full. First-year undergraduate students from the Mongolian University of Science and Technology who are recipients of the Mongolian Presidential Scholarship Program 'ILGEELT-2100'. Evidence: “対象学生は、モンゴル国大統領奨学金プログラム「ILGEELT-2100」の奨学生であり、モンゴル全土から選抜された優秀な学生です。”

item.title: モンゴル人留学生支援奨学金
item.description: Eligible. Japan, full. Mongolian international students studying at Chuo University. Evidence: “本学では、モンゴルにゆかりのある卒業生および本学関係者からのご寄附による「モンゴル人留学生支援奨学金」を創設し、2022年度以降、延べ4名のモンゴル人留学生に対する支援を行ってきました。”

item.title: Грант на обучение в Китае 2027: CSC и другие стипендии
item.description: Eligible. China, bachelor, master, phd, full. International students, including those from CIS countries (such as Russia), are eligible to apply for CSC Type B scholarships directly to Chinese universities. Specific routes like Type A may be restricted to citizens of certain countries through their respective national agencies. Evidence: “Для абитуриентов из России и СНГ участие в CSC и провинциальных грантах формально открыто наравне со всеми странами - в списке участников программ вроде «Силк Роуд» Россия указана прямо.”

item.title: Стипендия Erasmus Mundus 2027: сумма и условия | StudyU
item.description: Eligible. Multiple, master, full. Bachelor's graduates or final-year students from any country are eligible to apply. The scholarship is open to students from all over the world. Evidence: “В правилах сказано, что стипендии EMJM могут получать студенты со всего мира.”

item.title: Стипендия GKS в Корее 2027: суммы, треки и сроки подачи
item.description: Eligible. South Korea, bachelor, master, phd, research, full. International students (non-Korean citizens) for undergraduate (GKS-U) and graduate (GKS-G) programs. For the Embassy Track, quotas are allocated by country. The UIC University Track is open to applicants from any country except Korea. Evidence: “Монголия в СНГ и в бывший СССР не входит, но тоже получила квоту Embassy Track на бакалавриат 2027 года: 2 места General, 2 R-GKS, итого 4.”

item.title: Стипендии Маастрихтского университета 2027 в Нидерландах — полное финансирование
item.description: Eligible. Deadline 2027-02-01. Netherlands, bachelor, master, full. Students from countries outside the EU/EEA who are applying for specific undergraduate or master's programs at Maastricht University. Evidence: “Студенты из стран за пределами ЕС/ЕЭЗ”

item.title: Стипендиум Хунгарикум: суммы, страны и сроки 2027/28
item.description: Unclear. Hungary, bachelor, master, other, phd, language, short_course, full. International students from partner countries (including CIS countries like Russia, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, etc.) can apply through their respective national nominating authorities. Applicants must hold citizenship of a partner country and cannot be Hungarian citizens or refugees/asylum seekers in Hungary. Evidence: “По официальным данным программы, на конкурс 2026/2027 учебного года в ней участвуют более 100 стран-отправителей на пяти континентах.”

item.title: DAAD + 20 прочих стипендий в Германии 💸 2026/27
item.description: Eligible. Germany, bachelor, master, postdoc, phd, full. International students wishing to study in Germany are eligible. DAAD offers various funding options depending on nationality and field of study. Some specific funds like KAAD target students from Africa, Asia, Latin America, the Middle East, and parts of Europe. Evidence: “Германская служба академических обменов (DAAD) является крупнейшей немецкой организацией, финансирующей международное академическое сотрудничество, и, следовательно, является крупнейшим источником стипендий для иностранных студентов, желающих учиться в Германии.”

item.title: 2026-2027 оны хичээлийн жилийн БНХАУ-ын Өвөр Монголын Өөртөө Засах Орны (ӨМӨЗО) Засгийн газрын тэтгэлэгт оюутан элсүүлэх тухай мэдэгдэл
item.description: Eligible. China, bachelor, master, phd, full. Mongolian citizens applying for bachelor, master, or doctoral programs for the 2026-2027 academic year. Evidence: “2026-2027 оны хичээлийн жилд БНХАУ-ын ӨМӨЗО-ны Засгийн газраас Монгол Улсын Засгийн газарт нийт 260 хүнд тэтгэлэг олгохоос бакалавр 200, магистр 40, доктор 20 байна.”

item.title: БҮГД НАЙРАМДАХ БОЛГАР УЛСЫН ЗАСГИЙН ГАЗРЫН 2026–2027 ОНЫ ХИЧЭЭЛИЙН ЖИЛИЙН ТЭТГЭЛЭГ ЗАРЛАГДЛАА
item.description: Eligible. Bulgaria, bachelor, master, phd, full. Citizens of Mongolia are eligible for 8 scholarships for the 2026-2027 academic year. Bachelor's programs are in Bulgarian (with 1 year of language prep), while Master's and PhD programs are in Bulgarian or English. Evidence: “Монгол Улсын Засгийн газар, Бүгд Найрамдах Болгар Улсын Засгийн газар хоорондын соёл, боловсрол, шинжлэх ухааны салбарт хамтран ажиллах хөтөлбөрийн хүрээнд 2026–2027 оны хичээлийн жилд Монгол Улсын иргэдэд нийт 8 тэтгэлэг олгоно.”

item.title: 2026 оны GKS-G (Магистр, Докторантур) 2,000 оюутан шалгаруулах хөтөч: Бүрэн тэтгэлэг болон амьжиргааны тэтгэмжийн дэлгэрэнгүй мэдээлэл | HaniSeoul
item.description: Eligible. South Korea, master, phd, research, full. International students applying for graduate degrees (Master's, Doctoral, or Research programs) in South Korea. Evidence: “БНСУ-ын Засгийн газрын тэтгэлэгт гадаад оюутны магистр, докторын (GKS-G) хөтөлбөрийн танилцуулга”

item.title: 2027 оны GKS-U тэтгэлгийн тэтгэмж: Сургалтын төлбөр, онгоцны тийз, жилд 13,56 сая/14,4 сая воны сургалтын тэтгэмж | HaniSeoul
item.description: Eligible. South Korea, bachelor, full. Applicants must be non-Korean citizens; both the applicant and both parents must be foreign nationals. Evidence: “Өргөдөл гаргагч өөрөө болон эцэг эх хоёулаа гадаад улсын иргэн байх ёстой бөгөөд Солонгосын иргэншилтэй давхар иргэншилтэй хүмүүс хамрагдах боломжгүй.”

item.title: ЗГ-ын Тэтгэлэг
item.description: Eligible. Russia, bachelor, master, phd, research, short_course, full. Mongolian high school graduates, students of Mongolian or Russian schools in Mongolia, and university students. Open to adults interested in Bachelor, Master, Specialist, or PhD degrees, regardless of age. Evidence: “Монгол улсад тэтгэлэгт хуваарийн тоог 2013 оноос эхлэн 300-аас эхлэн үе шаттайгаар нэмэгдүүлсээр сүүлийн дөрвөн жил бакалавр, магистр, доктор, мэргэжил дээшлүүлэх, зуны сургалтын 600 гаруй тэтгэлэгт хөтөлбөрийг монголын хүүхэд залуучуудад олгодог болоод байна.”

item.title: Япон улсын засгийн газрын тэтгэлэгт хөтөлбөр
item.description: Eligible. Japan, bachelor, postdoc, research, full. Applicants must be citizens of Mongolia, born on or after April 2, 1999, and meet specific educational requirements (12th grade student, university student, or college student). Applicants must have a minimum GPA of 3.5 and be in good physical and mental health. Evidence: “Иргэншил: | Монгол Улсын иргэн байх”

item.title: The Coca-Cola Scholars Program Scholarship
item.description: Unclear. United States, bachelor, full. Applicants must be high school students currently attending school in one of the 50 U.S. states, D.C., Puerto Rico, or select DoD schools, graduating in the 2026-2027 academic year. They must be U.S. Citizens, U.S. Nationals, U.S. Permanent Residents, Refugees, Asylees, Cuban-Haitian Entrants, or Humanitarian Parolees, and plan to attend an accredited U.S. post-secondary institution. International students are not eligible. Evidence: “International students (with the exception of students at DoD schools) are not eligible for this award”

item.title: [Japan] Kyoto University – Asian Future Leaders Scholarship Program (AFLSP) for April 2027
item.description: Unclear. Deadline 2026-11-13. Japan, master, full. Students from Universitas Gadjah Mada expecting to enroll in a master's-level degree program, committed to the BXAl Summer Program, with high English proficiency and strong personal integrity. Evidence: “We are pleased to inform you that the application for Asian Future Leaders Scholarship Program (AFLSP) for April 2027 is now open for Universitas Gadjah Mada students.”

item.title: ISQOLS Developing Country Fellowship
item.description: Eligible. Deadline 2026-11-15. research, full. Early-career scholars currently residing in a developing country who are conducting research related to quality of life, happiness, and/or well-being studies. Evidence: “supporting an early-career scholar residing in a developing country who is conducting research related to quality of life, happiness, and/or well-being studies.”

item.title: MOPGA 2027: Visiting Fellowship Program for Early Career Researchers
item.description: Eligible. Deadline 2026-12-15. France, postdoc, full. Early career researchers who hold a doctoral degree awarded between December 2021 and December 2026. Applicants must be of foreign nationality (excluding French nationality), not be residing or professionally active in France at the time of application, and must not have previously received a MOPGA fellowship. Evidence: “Be exclusively of foreign nationality (all nationalities are eligible except French nationality);”

item.title: 10 Fully Funded Scholarships for Asian Students 2026-27 — MEXT | GKS | DAAD | Amounts & Deadlines
item.description: Eligible. Multiple, bachelor, master, phd, full. Open to students from Asian countries. Specific requirements vary by scholarship, including citizenship of eligible countries, minimum GPA, and work experience. Evidence: “Below are the 10 best fully funded scholarships open to Asian students in 2026-27 — with exact deadlines, what each one covers, who qualifies, and what the selection committee is actually looking for.”

item.title: Gulf Research Program Early-Career Research Fellowships
item.description: Unclear. United States, full. Early-career scientists, engineers, and health professionals at the pre-tenure phase of their careers working on oil system safety, environmental protection, and human health issues relevant to the Gulf region.

item.title: Newton International Fellowships | Royal Society
item.description: Eligible. United Kingdom, postdoc, full. Early career researchers with a PhD and no more than five years of active full-time postdoctoral experience. Applicants must be based outside the UK, not hold UK citizenship, and be of any nationality. Evidence: “Applicants can be of any nationality and those requiring a visa are eligible to apply for a Global Talent Visa under the fast-track process of endorsement.”

item.title: HU Visits Mongolia's Ministry of Education to Strengthen Cooperation under the Presidential Scholarship Program "ILGEELT-2100"
item.description: Eligible. Japan, bachelor, full. High school graduates from Mongolia participating in the ILGEELT-2100 program, specifically those selected from across Mongolia. Evidence: “Selected from across Mongolia, the students are first-year undergraduates at the Mongolian University of Science and Technology.”

item.title: Scholarships & Funding | Go Abroad
Scholarships - Australia Awards - South Asia & Mongolia
item.description: Eligible. Australia, postdoc, full. Suitably qualified nationals of Bangladesh, Bhutan, Maldives, Nepal, Pakistan, Sri Lanka and Mongolia are eligible for full-time postgraduate study in Australia. Evidence: “Under the Australia Awards – South Asia & Mongolia program, they are open to suitably qualified nationals of Bangladesh, Bhutan, Maldives, Nepal, Pakistan, Sri Lanka and Mongolia.”

item.title: 2027 KOICA Scholarship Program
item.description: Eligible. South Korea, master, research, full. Applicants must be government officials from designated OECD DAC recipient countries, preferably under the age of 40, with a Bachelor's degree for Master's programs or a Master's degree for Doctoral programs. Evidence: “Republic, Malaysia, Maldives, Mongolia, Nepal, Pakistan, Philippines, Sri -”

item.title: Mongolian Government Scholarship (International Student Program) - eduatlashub.com
item.description: Eligible. Mongolia, master, bachelor, phd, postdoc, short_course, other, full. Open to international students from countries with diplomatic and educational ties to Mongolia who hold a high school diploma (for undergraduate) or a relevant university degree (for postgraduate) and meet specific age and health criteria. Evidence: “Aimed at international students from countries with diplomatic and educational ties to mongolia, Mongolian Government Scholarship (International Student Program) is a fully funded scholarship for study in Mongolia.”

item.title: Scholarships | Chevening
item.description: Eligible. United Kingdom, master, full. Outstanding emerging leaders from all over the world who wish to pursue a one-year master's degree in the UK. Evidence: “Chevening Scholarships enable outstanding emerging leaders from all over the world to pursue one-year master’s degrees in the UK.”

item.title: Засгийн газар хоорондын тэтгэлэг (Mongolia Government-to-Government Bilateral Scholarship)
item.description: Eligible. China, Japan, South Korea, Russia, France, Hungary, Turkey, Vietnam, United States, Australia, Laos, Belarus, Kazakhstan, Bulgaria, India, Romania, Cuba, Poland, United Kingdom, Czech Republic, Taiwan, bachelor, master, phd, full. Mongolian citizens admitted to priority-field degrees in 20+ partner countries. Evidence: “Mongolia's bilateral government-to-government scholarship covering living costs for citizens admitted to priority-field degrees in 20+ partner countries, Bachelor's through PhD.”

item.title: Home
item.description: Unclear. United States, bachelor, full. Undergraduate students over 18 years of age who are citizens of a participating country, currently residing there, enrolled in an accredited university with at least one year remaining, have a solid command of English, and are eligible for a J-1 visa. Evidence: “a citizen of a UGRAD participating country, currently residing in that country;”

item.title: The Rhodes Scholarship
item.description: Eligible. United Kingdom, postdoc, full. Talented people from around the world can apply for this merit-based postgraduate award to study full-time at the University of Oxford. Evidence: “The Rhodes Scholarship is a fully-funded postgraduate award which enables talented people from around the world to study full-time at the University of Oxford.”

item.title: Fulbright Visiting Scholar Program
item.description: Eligible. Deadline 2026-10-31. United States, phd, full. Mongolian citizens currently living in Mongolia who hold a doctoral degree or equivalent, have at least 10 years of full-time work experience, and possess excellent English skills. U.S. permanent residents are ineligible. Evidence: “Be a Mongolian citizen, currently living in Mongolia”

item.title: Master's Degree Program | Mongolia | JDS
item.description: Eligible. Deadline 2026-11-25. Japan, master, full. Citizens of Mongolia, aged 25 to 45 as of April 1, 2027, holding a Bachelor's Degree and currently employed as Core Civil Servants or officers of the Bank of Mongolia / Development Bank of Mongolia with at least two years of full-time work experience. Evidence: “Nationality | Citizens of Mongolia |”

item.title: Hubert H. Humphrey Fellowship
item.description: Eligible. United States, postdoc, master, full. Mid-career professionals from over 100 eligible countries. The program is a non-degree fellowship focused on leadership and professional development. Evidence: “The Hubert H. Humphrey Fellowship Program, a Fulbright exchange, advances American interests by bringing influential professionals from priority countries to the United States to build strategic partnerships that advance shared interests and support U.S. foreign policy goals.”

item.title: Mongolian Government Scholarships for International Students: Eligibility, Benefits and How to Apply | Titans Abroad
item.description: Eligible. Mongolia, bachelor, master, phd, full. The scholarship is available to citizens of partner countries through bilateral agreements with Mongolia. Applicants must meet academic entry requirements, be in good health, not hold conflicting scholarships, and meet the language proficiency requirements of the host university. Evidence: “It is part of a national strategy to raise the international profile of Mongolian higher education, and it is designed around cultural and academic cooperation between Mongolia and partner nations.”

item.title: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC) — Fully Funded
item.description: Eligible. China, bachelor, master, phd, postdoc, full. Mongolian students are eligible for the CSC scholarship, with specific quotas allocated by the Chinese Embassy in Mongolia for both new admissions and continuing students. Evidence: “The Chinese Embassy in Mongolia allocates 220 scholarships annually under the Chinese Government Scholarship program — 138 continuing students and 82 new admissions (46 undergraduates + 36 master’s/doctoral/general/advanced students).”

item.title: Australia Research Training Program (RTP) Scholarships 2026-2027 | Scholars4Dev
item.description: Eligible. Australia, research, master, phd, full. The scholarship is available to both domestic and international students enrolled in an accredited higher degree by research (HDR) course at a participating Australian higher education provider. Evidence: “The RTP provides block grants, on a calendar year basis, to higher education providers (HEPs) to support both domestic and overseas students undertaking Research Doctorate and Research Masters degrees, known as higher degrees by research (HDRs).”

item.title: Lester B. Pearson International Scholarship Program at University of Toronto 2026-2027 | Scholars4Dev
item.description: Eligible. Deadline 2026-11-07. Canada, bachelor, full. International students (non-Canadians requiring a study permit) who are in their final year of high school or graduated after June 2026, and are beginning studies at the University of Toronto in September 2027. Evidence: “International students from around the world, including international students studying at Canadian high schools.”

item.title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program in USA 2026-2027 | Scholars4Dev
item.description: Eligible. United States, master, phd, full. Graduate students, young professionals, and artists from international students from 155 countries around the world. Evidence: “International students from 155 countries around the world”

item.title: Justus & Louise van Effen Excellence Scholarships for International Students at TU Delft 2026-2027 | Scholars4Dev
item.description: Eligible. Deadline 2026-12-01. Netherlands, master, full. Excellent international applicants admitted to a 2-year regular TU Delft MSc programme who are in the top 10% of their previous study programme. Evidence: “The Delft University of Technology offers a number of excellence scholarship programs for international students.”

item.title: Reach Oxford Scholarships for Developing Country Students 2026-2027 | Scholars4Dev
item.description: Eligible. Deadline 2027-01-26. United Kingdom, bachelor, full. Applicants must be nationals of OECD DAC recipient countries, have received an offer from the University of Oxford, demonstrate high academic ability, and show financial need. They should intend to return to their home country after studies. Evidence: “Applicants must be nationals of countries who receive official development assistance from the Development Assistance Committee (DAC) of the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD.”

item.title: International Scholars Program at University of British Columbia 2026-2027 | Scholars4Dev
item.description: Eligible. Deadline 2026-11-15. Canada, bachelor, full. International students entering UBC for their first undergraduate degree who demonstrate superior academic achievement and significant financial need. Applicants must be studying in Canada on a Canadian study permit and must be nominated by their school or a non-profit. Evidence: “UBC’s International Scholars Program offers four categories of prestigious need-and-merit-based awards to international students:”

item.title: Oxford-Weidenfeld and Hoffmann Scholarship and Leadership Programme 2026-2027 | Scholars4Dev
item.description: Eligible. United Kingdom, master, full. Outstanding students from transition and emerging economies in Africa, Asia, and South America. Applicants must be applying for a new full-time graduate course at Oxford, intend to return to their country of residence after studies, and demonstrate how their studies will contribute to public life in their country of origin. Evidence: “Students from transition and emerging economies throughout Africa, Asia and South America: Afghanistan, Albania, Algeria, Angola, Argentina, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Bangladesh, Belarus, Belize, Benin, Bhutan, Bolivia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Botswana, Brazil, Bulgaria, Burkina Faso, Burundi, Cambodia, ”

item.title: Clarendon Fund Scholarships at University of Oxford 2026-2027 | Scholars4Dev
item.description: Eligible. Deadline 2027-01-01. United Kingdom, master, phd, full. Open to all graduate students from around the world applying for a new master's or DPhil course based on academic excellence. Evidence: “Clarendon Scholarships are awarded on the basis of outstanding academic merit and potential to graduate students from all around the world.”

item.title: Fellowship Program (CIAT)
item.description: Eligible. South Korea, full. Public sector representatives, including public officials, engineers, researchers, and policymakers from developing countries. Evidence: “KOICA invites public officials, engineers, researchers, and policymakers from developing countries to provide capacity-strengthening and training in various areas, with a focus on sharing Korea's development experience and technology.”

item.title: World Bank Scholarships Program - JJ/WBGSP
item.description: Eligible. Deadline 2027-02-26. United States, Europe, Africa, Oceania, Japan, master, full. Citizens of certain developing countries with relevant professional experience and a history of supporting their countries’ development efforts who are applying to a master's degree program in a development-related topic. Evidence: “The JJ/WBGSP is open to citizens of certain developing countries with relevant professional experience and a history of supporting their countries’ development efforts who are applying to a master's degree program in a development-related topic.”

item.title: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships at a Glance
item.description: Eligible. Switzerland, master, phd, research, full. The scholarship is available to applicants from over 180 countries, specifically targeting international exchange and research cooperation. It includes research fellowships, PhD scholarships, and art scholarships for students wishing to obtain their first Master's degree in Switzerland. Applicants from non-EU/EFTA countries receive certain additional benefits like health insurance and return flight allowances. Evidence: “Each year the Swiss Confederation awards Government Excellence Scholarships to encourage international exchange and research cooperation between Switzerland and over 180 other countries.”

item.title: The Stefan Banach Scholarship Programme
item.description: Eligible. Poland, full. The programme is part of the 'Foreign Students' category offered by NAWA, intended for international students to study in Poland. Evidence: “Programmes for foreign students”

item.title: Banach NAWA Scholarship Programme
item.description: Eligible. Poland, master, full. Applicants must be citizens of one of the specified eligible countries (including Mongolia) and must have obtained their Bachelor's degree in one of those same countries. Applicants must not have Polish citizenship and must not already hold a Master's degree. Evidence: “Applicants must be citizens and must have obtained their degree in of one of the following countries: Albania, Angola, Argentina, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Brazil, Georgia, India, Indonesia, Iraq, Iran, Jordan, Kazakhstan, Kenya, Kosovo, Lebanon, Mexico, Moldova, Mongolia”

item.title: Apply Now
item.description: Unclear. Deadline 2027-03-15. Taiwan, full. Applicants must complete an online application for either the TaiwanICDF Scholarship or the Taiwan-Europe Scholarship.

item.description: Eligible. Australia, master, full. Applicants must be from Mongolia, hold a full-time bachelor's degree with a minimum GPA of 3.0, and meet English language requirements (IELTS 6.0). Most applicants must demonstrate at least two years of continuous employment in Mongolia, though this is waived for those with verified disabilities. Applicants who already hold a PhD or a Master's funded by Mongolian-bilateral government schemes are ineligible. Evidence: “In addition to the eligibility requirements, candidates from Mongolia must also meet the following country-specific conditions:”

item.description: Eligible. Hungary, bachelor, master, phd, postdoc, short_course, full.
